behaviour-switch.answer: The switch is DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/DialectBehavior.cs:301), read only by CompileTimeArithmetic.For (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs:44), which picks the mode for operand entry and + - * / inside a compile-time arithmetic expression (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1; its 34-digit 2002 mode against §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1's 32 digits is the known PB5575-family defect, reaching only results of arithmetic operations). Line placement of the >>EVALUATE phrases and of text-1/text-2 is decided on the directive lines before any operand is evaluated, so no arithmetic operation enters it and the switch cannot change it.
